DocumentReadingWindows borrows only matching root/resolvedPath coordinates, filters against actual original part/elementPath/kind and clamps to the new document. A new document object remounts local paragraph/table state even if file fields match.

The map stores at most 128 bounded coordinate records and no body text. Save requires the exact known block and current active ref owner; an old different owner cannot overwrite or release a newer one.

Parent callback ownership, active/ready and feedback gates remain separate from approximate reading location. A reading position is not a live feedback anchor or proof of semantic continuity across versions.
